name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks quickstart and received a chat completion from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API. The response was "¡Hola!" from the glm-5p2 model.
deviations: The quickstart specifies model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`, but that model returned a 404 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed' error. I queried the available models endpoint (`https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1/models`) to find an accessible model and used `accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2` instead, which worked successfully.

configured.evidence: curl -s https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1/models -H "Authorization: Bearer $FIREWORKS_API_KEY" | head -c 2000 returned valid JSON model list
